name: orb_failure_trade_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY breaks above its 15-minute ORB high (09:15-09:30) but closes back inside the range within 30-90 seconds, it creates a 'bull trap' — breakout buyers who entered at the ORB high are immediately underwater and NIFTY's deep liquidity means they cut losses rapidly rather than hold. Market makers who delta-hedged their short calls during the upside breakout (buying futures) now reverse those hedges on the failure, creating a concentrated selling cascade that typically carries NIFTY 15-25 spot points below the ORB high within the next 60-120 seconds. The 5-second resolution lets us enter the reversal 30-55 seconds earlier than a 1-minute bar system — before the bulk of trapped-long liquidation completes — capturing a clean, directional entry at the turn.

indicators.name: orb_high_15
indicators.formula: max(high) for bars where time_minutes in [555, 570)
indicators.purpose: Fixed time window 09:15-09:30 — same 15 minutes as the original regardless of bar size (180 bars at 5s vs 15 bars at 1-min). The 15-minute ORB on NIFTY is the institutional consensus supply/demand reference: the first 15 minutes absorbs overnight information, and a break above/below is treated as directional by algos and humans alike.

indicators.name: orb_low_15
indicators.formula: min(low) for bars where time_minutes in [555, 570)
indicators.purpose: See orb_high_15 — symmetric lower bound of the 15-minute ORB.

indicators.name: rsi_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute RSI at 5-second bars (12 bars × 5s = 60 seconds). The original used RSI(14) on 1-min bars; we use 12 bars to capture the SAME 1-minute momentum window at 5s resolution. This is a momentum confirmation filter: for a failed-up breakout (buy PE), RSI should not be extreme-overbought (<60 confirms momentum is turning); for a failed-down (buy CE), RSI > 40 confirms momentum is recovering. Not scaled 12x because we are matching the original's 1-minute window, not extending it.

indicators.name: bars_since_breakout
indicators.formula: bars elapsed since close crossed ORB boundary
indicators.purpose: Counter tracking how quickly the failure occurs after the breakout. Faster failures (within 12 bars = 60 seconds) are higher probability reversals because they indicate the breakout had no real buying interest. Slow failures (15+ bars) may be consolidations before continuation. Capped at 12 bars (tunable) — the original's '15 bars on 1-min = 15 minutes' is too slow for 5s entry; we focus on the first 30-90 seconds where trapped-long liquidation is most acute.

conditions: breakout_type == -1: NIFTY closed below orb_low_15 (downward breakout occurred)
bars_since_breakout <= failure_bars (default 12, tunable 6-24): failure within 60s of breakout
close > orb_low_15: price has returned inside the ORB range (confirmed failure)
rsi_12 > 45.0 (tunable 35-55): momentum turning positive after false breakdown
time_minutes in [570, 600): entry only in 09:30-10:00 window for highest-probability fresh ORB failures
vix_close in [13.0, 22.0]: VIX filter — skip if panic (>22) or ultra-low volatility (<13)
buy_ce.confirmation: single bar confirmation — close back above orb_low_15 is sufficient at 5s resolution; waiting for 2 bars (as in original) would delay entry by 10 seconds and miss the entry point

conditions: breakout_type == +1: NIFTY closed above orb_high_15 (upward breakout occurred)
bars_since_breakout <= failure_bars (default 12, tunable 6-24): failure within 60s of breakout
close < orb_high_15: price has returned inside the ORB range (confirmed failure)
rsi_12 < 55.0 (tunable 45-65): momentum turning negative after false breakout
time_minutes in [570, 600): entry only in 09:30-10:00 window
buy_pe.confirmation: single bar — close back below orb_high_15

exit.stop_rationale: If NIFTY re-breaks the ORB level after our entry (thesis completely invalidated), spot moves 8-10 pts beyond the level → ~4 option pts at delta 0.5. A re-break within 30 seconds means we had a false failure — trapped longs actually continued buying. 4 pts allows the position a single 5-second bar of noise without being stopped by microstructure, while promptly exiting on genuine re-breaks.
exit.target_rationale: Failed ORB breakouts on NIFTY typically reverse 20-30 spot points toward the ORB midpoint/opposite extreme within 60-90 seconds. 7 option pts ≈ 14 spot pts at delta 0.5, capturing roughly 50-60% of the expected reversal and leaving a comfortable buffer. Risk-reward is 1:1.75 (4 stop : 7 target), which with a 55%+ win rate on fresh ORB failures yields positive expected value at this cost structure.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX between 13 and 22 — above 22 means gap risk and ORB ranges widen to a point where failed breakouts become continuation traps; below 13 means too little volatility to reach the 7-pt target
filters.time_filter: entry only 09:30-10:00 IST (time_min 570-600) — ORB failures in the first 30 minutes are highest-probability because the ORB is freshly formed and institutional algos haven't repositioned yet
filters.volume_filter: not applied — NIFTY index volume is aggregated and noisy at 5s; the ORB level itself acts as the filter
filters.trend_filter: none required — the failed breakout direction IS the trade signal; adding a trend filter would conflict with the counter-trend nature of the strategy
filters.spread_filter: not applicable — limit order execution at candle close, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — psychologically difficult to fade a fresh breakout on NIFTY; most algo systems are momentum-following and don't trade ORB failures, limiting crowding

adaptation_notes: Original trades NIFTY 50 constituent equities with stock-specific filters (volume > ₹200cr, no news, bid-ask < 0.05%). All equity-specific filters dropped — trading NIFTY index directly eliminates single-stock event risk. Entry confirmation reduced from 2 bars to 1 bar because at 5-second resolution a 2-bar delay (10 seconds) misses the sharpest entry and adds slippage. RSI lookback reduced from 14 bars (14 minutes at 1-min) to 12 bars (1 minute at 5s) because we need momentum confirmation at the 1-minute scale, not the 14-minute scale. Entry window tightened to 09:30-10:00 (original allowed 09:30-14:30) because late-session ORB failures are weak — the ORB becomes less relevant as price discovers new intraday ranges. Hold time compressed from 15-90 min to 15-120 seconds because NIFTY index is more mean-reverting at the micro scale and the trapped-long liquidation completes within 2 minutes.
weaknesses: Distinguishing a genuine false breakout from a brief re-test before continuation is hard even at 5s; adding the RSI filter reduces but doesn't eliminate this ambiguity
The 09:30-10:00 entry window is tight — if no clean breakout-and-failure occurs in those 30 minutes, strategy fires zero trades; high zero-trade-day frequency
On strong directional trend days (e.g., large macro event at 09:30), ORB breakouts with immediate apparent 'failures' can be absorptions before a larger move — the trade fires into a continuing trend
